description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractPolicyMongoEventAdapter' that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface for converting policy-related events to and from MongoDB journal entries. It includes methods for serializing, deserializing, migrating payloads, and handling JSON representations of policy events in a persistence layer within an Eclipse Ditto service context.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyMongoEventAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the EventAdapter interface, responsible for serializing and deserializing policy events to and from MongoDB journal entries, with JSON handling and payload migration support.

methods.name: manifest
methods.description: Creates a manifest string for the given event, based on its type if it is a PolicyEvent.

methods.name: toJournal
methods.description: Serializes a PolicyEvent into a JSON object and then converts it into a MongoDB-compatible format for journaling.

methods.name: fromJournal
methods.description: Deserializes a journal entry (BsonValue) back into an Event object.

methods.name: tryToCreateEventFrom
methods.description: Attempts to create an Event from a JSON value, handling exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: createEventFrom
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to create an Event from a JSON value.

methods.name: migratePayload
methods.description: Migrates old payload formats within JSON objects to the current format for compatibility.
